title: Research: complete the paid high-cube traffic composition
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

[PR2982](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2982)'s complete-prefix wrapper and [PR3233](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3233)/[PR3265](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3265)'s ADD/setup invoices leave the unit-translation and whole-swap-adapter charges uncomposed. This source proof and bounded replay supply those missing bounds, transfer the sign bound to its actual pooled caller, and close the conditional local high-cube tape bill while retaining every complete native B1 interval.

For cube volume V, factor count s, ADD/scaling/negation/translation counts a,h,g,c, and t swaps plus twice the reversed ADDs, the result is

```text
T_cube <= sum_j A_j + 27I + 10K
          + [373+s(3B_N+36)+4096a+530h+4096g+32768c+100000t] V,
B_N = 716+1866 bit_length(d²).
```

Here each A_j is the entire actual `native.run` toll. The new unit-translation bound is <1024V, the complete carry-translation kernel is <32768V, and the whole swap adapter costs at most A_j+100000V. PROOF.md derives the bounds from source loops and states the canonical encoding, ownership, capacity and native endpoint premises. PR2982's prefix overhead is added once. Conditional on the inherited same-domain native tariff, this yields the local O(V(1+u^p)) bound.

The isolated package includes the proof, source-bound observer/checker, exact receipt, task/verification manifests and attributed hash-checked copies of the two pending proof dependencies. Frozen sources and the selected record are unchanged.

## Validation

Validation on macOS with standard-library CPython 3.12.12 at `5ce521090c869211f808d132e28dcd4946f798c4`:

- `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-cube-paid-composition`: normal and optimized runs pass; 14 complete packets, 9,654 Boolean coordinates, 48 actual elementary native calls, all six factor kinds, both ADD orientations, nonidentity low rows, occupied scratch roles and six controls.
- Exact partitions agree with separate physical observation and raw meters. Additional radix scans reach 268-bit words without exponential payload allocation.
- Committed-byte check passes for all 38 package/input files; checked export and direct replay from a fresh directory without Git pass. `git diff origin/main --check` passes.

Limits: successful execution only; conservative constants; no fitted/GL64 native payload, native all-width proof, full machine-step/backing/stock ledger, formal proof or new kappa. This is author-checked automated evidence, awaiting independent review. Credited pending component claims remain explicit premises, not admissions inferred from archival intake.

## Task and overlap

Coordination: [canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19004103). Base main remains `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Task `selected-stock-envelope` has **changed scope**, declared in TASK.json: the released local traffic handoff resolves a missing C1 routing implication, without assigning a whole-stage stock coefficient. The domain is canonical Q=q^u with odd q>=3, successful execution, sufficient capacity and the explicit native contract.

Exact predecessors: PR2915 `fecc5a87574df441ddc3dad44f99fca9bd7fdd92`; PR2982 `b9ac0d07eb9cdc31c4dca8dcc218943998edd3e8`; pending PR3233 `803f3593e8f00ed8591d5ff6fc69ce2a036a3293` and PR3265 `ac651ec18e62edf0baf3846cc4bf0a11d335c2b4`. The package pins the activated source closure and preserves exact copies of both pending proof dependencies.

Entry search covered 336 open PRs, 2,630 closed PRs and 2,129 Discussion records; the publication refresh covered 344 open PRs and 2,142 Discussion records, with complete pagination and no warnings. Related hits were the credited predecessors or separate work; metadata search does not certify absence of unpublished overlap.

## Open next questions

The [package's next questions](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5ce521090c869211f808d132e28dcd4946f798c4/research/high-cube-paid-composition/README.md#open-next-questions) separate fitted native admission from the enclosing backing/control ledger. The smallest useful follow-up is to pin one genuinely fitted B1 call and discharge its full spectator, ownership, restoration and uniform-cost contract. Elementary fixtures do not resolve its inherited PR2753/2809/2899 premises.
